# Agent Kammer

Agent Kammer is a Manhattan housing decision platform for people deciding whether to buy, sell, rent, wait, renew, renovate, refinance, rent their current home, or do nothing yet.

The site is organized around Decision Briefs, Building Intelligence, and the Guidance Captain conversation layer.

## Core URLs

- Homepage: https://www.agentkammer.com/
- Decision Briefs: https://www.agentkammer.com/services
- Buyer Advisory: https://www.agentkammer.com/buyer-advisory
- Building Intelligence: https://www.agentkammer.com/building-reports
- Contact: https://www.agentkammer.com/contact

## Positioning

Agent Kammer does not start with listings. It starts with what changed, whether anything should change, what the real options are, and which recommendation protects the client best.
